items.title: Sensient Sinks 12% as Revenue Miss and Unchanged Outlook Overshadow Earnings Beat
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSensient shares fell 12% today as third-quarter revenue came in just short of estimates, though earnings per share beat. The beat didn’t lift the top of Sensient’s 2026 earnings range, and after a gain of about 40% this year, investors wanted more.
